reason: I put the same amount into index funds every month and don't look, and that already works fine. A cartoon pet that trades and rebalances for me is the opposite of what I want from my money: boring, set-and-forget, and nothing to babysit.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money, and there's no broker, no price and no track record yet, so I'd be signing up for a waitlist to hand real savings to an app whose main feature is a pet.
would_change_my_mind: If it were with a broker I already recognize and cost clearly less than my robo-adviser for the same hands-off index investing, with the pet something I could switch off.
